# DockSplitterZoneIdNL selects a splitter that a restored boot's refresh replaces

## Context

`DockSplitterZoneIdNL.spec.mjs` AC3 boots the Workstation three times in one page and requires each boot's first `drag:start` to carry its zone id. In the Brain-gated burn-in it fails at boot 2 or 3, never at boot 1. It was red on both attempts of the retry in [dev run 38313618683](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38313618683), and in most ten-shard `dev` runs since.

## The Problem

The test selects its splitter before a restored boot's dock has settled.
- Boot 1 starts with empty storage, so the Workspace projects its dock once. Boots 2 and 3 restore the topology boot 1 saved. `ViewportController#createRoot()` constructs the Workspace from it, then writes it through the Group as a `cold-hydrate` transaction. That write re-projects the dock after its first render: splitters 1–5 are replaced by 6–10, and 1–5 are torn down about half a second later.
- The test waits only for `.workstation-dock-host`, then takes the first horizontal splitter from the vdom. Before the refresh lands, that is `…-splitter-1`, which the refresh replaces. The drag's first `drag:start` then carries no zone.

Observed, on probes from an unmerged branch:
- [Run 38317881739](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38317881739), red 6 of 6: every failing boot had selected `…-splitter-1`.
- [Run 38319422351](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38319422351), green 6 of 6, with every register and unregister logged. On boots 2 and 3, `…-splitter-6` registered at about 1.1–1.4 s, `…-splitter-1` to `-5` unregistered at about 1.6–1.9 s, and the test dragged `-splitter-6`.
- Boot 3 reuses `neo-dragzone-6` and `…-splitter-6`, so ids restart on every boot. With a single page, the worker does not survive this spec's `page.goto`.

## The Architectural Reality

- `apps/workstation/view/ViewportController.mjs` `createRoot()`: hydrate, construct the Workspace, `Transaction.write({cause: 'cold-hydrate'})`, then `view.add(workspace)`.
- `src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs` `refreshPromise` is the settled-surface contract: a consumer that must observe a settled surface awaits it. `refreshDockWorkspace()` awaits the host's mount before it reconciles, so the first projection always renders first.
- Sibling specs await it after a committed operation: `app.callMethod(id, 'refreshPromise.then')`.

## The Fix

The spec's `boot()` finds the page's Workspace and awaits its recorded refresh before it selects the splitter. A fresh boot records none (`refreshPromise` stays `null`) and skips the wait.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] AC-1: `boot()` awaits the Workspace's recorded refresh before it selects the splitter, and skips the wait when none is recorded. (#19702)
- [x] AC-2: A hosted A/B, interleaved on one runner: the fixed spec passes every round, and the `dev` spec fails at least one round, so the run is known to reproduce the race. ([Run 38323201218](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38323201218): the `dev` copy failed 1 of 8, the fix passed 8 of 8.)
- [x] AC-3: Post-merge, the spec passes in the next ten-shard `dev` run. ([Run 38326477238](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38326477238): first attempt, whole burn-in green.)

## Out of Scope

- Whether a restored boot should project its dock twice. The second projection rebuilds every splitter and registers its zones again. That is a question for the dock, not this failure.

## Corrections

Two earlier versions of this ticket were wrong:
- **A guarded keyed delete in `unregisterZone`.** On a head carrying it, the spec still failed 3 of 6 rounds ([run 38318942599](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38318942599)). The keyed-delete defect is unit-proven but is not this failure, and its branch is dropped.
- **"Two app generations in a surviving SharedWorker, with the old generation's zone traffic reaching the new window."** Boot 3 reusing `neo-dragzone-6` refutes it. Both projections belong to the same boot, in the same window.
